verdict.rationale: Rippling's first-party pages describe user-defined dynamic rules and custom workflows that run without manual action. Examples include automatic access provisioning and revocation on role changes, threat notifications, and an AI-triggered device retrieval flow on offboarding, summed up as "You define the rules, Rippling runs the rest." All of this comes from marketing-level vendor claims, with no detailed docs or hands-on confirmation of how users author these automations. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the workflow builder (triggers, conditions, scheduling, monitoring of background runs), independent or hands-on corroboration that agentic automations run reliably unattended.
